title: Assessing 3D tree model quality and species classification using imbalance indices
summary: We investigate the use of additional 3D and phylogenetic non-3D tree balance indices for analyzing and monitoring forests using an exemplary "virtual forest" dataset from the Wytham Woods, Oxford, UK. This study assesses 3D model quality, species classification performance, and the relevance of these indices.
